Molly A.: Quick sync after the precision-profile RFC. Proposal: consolidate precision flags into a single 'precisionProfile' envelope and add a server-side compatibility shim. Need to call out cache/telemetry/enterprise overrides.
Diego C.: Agreed on envelope. Concern: runtime plugins read legacy flags today. We must ensure shim preserves exact semantics for toggles like 'disable_kv_quant'.
Priya R.: KV-cache invalidation is the big risk. If we change packing metadata format, nodes will fail to deserialize or misapply cached KV. Suggest a two-phase blob header versioning and read-fallback logic.
Molly A.: Two-phase it is: v1 blobs unchanged; new writes tag 'pp-hdr-v2' and include both old packing metadata and new profile pointer. Older nodes will ignore extra fields.
Diego C.: Telemetry note: we currently split APM traces by flag name. We should emit the canonical profile plus a legacy_label field for dashboards during rollout. Priya will coordinate mapping.
Priya R.: For enterprise overrides, we will map legacy override keys to profile names and expose a preview endpoint for customers to verify behavior before migration.
Molly A.: Canary rules: require 24h shadowing + degeneration score per-profile. If any profile regresses beyond threshold, auto-fallback. Ops: add an eviction playbook to clear stale KV caches for affected nodes.
ops-bot: scheduled: precision-profile-shim v0.9 -> staging at 2024-09-01T04:00Z.
Molly A.: Action items: Diego -> update runtime plugin compat tests. Priya -> header versioning + preview endpoint. I'll update SDK RFC and publisher deprecation notes.
Priya R.: I'll also write the migration kb with steps for ops and customers.
Molly A.: Thanks, team.
